# dspc_block_storage (Resource)

Manages a Block in the DSPC platform



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the block. Must be unique within the platform
- `size` (String) Size of the block storage (e.g. 10Gi)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the block. Must be unique within the platform
